map.按总工时与伤亡数据计算 FR（事故频率）、LTIFR（损工事件率）等安全指标，横: Compute safety indicators such as FR (accident frequency) and LTIFR (lost-time injury frequency rate) from total man-hours and casualty data, and compare them against industry benchmarks.
map.月度/年度汇总事故次数、伤亡人次、损工天数，生成统计报表。: Aggregate accident counts, casualty headcount, and lost days monthly or annually into a report.
map.用比率而非绝对数衡量，消除人数规模差异带来的偏差。: Measure with a rate rather than an absolute count, removing bias from differences in headcount.
map.：事故频率 FR = 伤亡人次 × 1,000,000 ÷ 总工时；损工事件率: : accident frequency FR = casualty headcount × 1,000,000 ÷ total man-hours; lost-time injury frequency rate LTIFR = lost-time injury count × 1,000,000 ÷ total man-hours; the million-man-hour fatality rate = deaths × 1,000,000 ÷ total man-hours. Using a million man-hours as the denominator makes figures comparable across scales.
map.：某厂年总工时 2,000,000 小时，年内伤亡 4 人次、损工事件 3 起、: : a plant with 2,000,000 man-hours a year, 4 casualty cases, 3 lost-time events, and 0 deaths gives FR = 4×1e6/2e6 = 2.0, LTIFR = 3×1e6/2e6 = 1.5, and a million-man-hour fatality rate of 0; against an industry FR benchmark of 3.0 that is better than the benchmark.

map.为什么用“百万工时”做分母？: Why Use "Million Man-Hours" as the Denominator?
map.工伤风险与暴露工时正相关，用百万工时归一化可消除人数与工时差异，使不同规模企业指: Injury risk correlates with exposed man-hours, so normalizing by a million man-hours removes differences in headcount and hours, making indicators comparable across company sizes.
map.FR 低就说明安全吗？: Does a Low FR Mean Things Are Safe?
map.不一定。FR 只看频次，还需结合严重率、近因事件与未遂事故综合判断；小伤频发也反: Not necessarily. FR only counts frequency; you also need the severity rate, recent incidents, and near misses. Frequent minor injuries also point to management problems.
